01 PORTEX
Port efficiency and competitor benchmarking intelligence
Port authoritiesTerminal operators

PORTEX measures your competitor's operation without ever entering it.

PORTEX gives port authorities a view beyond their own operational systems. It brings together relevant KPIs to benchmark performance against their competitors on a weekly basis.

Questions PORTEX is designed to answer
01What is the waiting time at our competitor port this week?
02How does their turnaround vary by vessel type or service?
03Where are delays emerging?
04Where are our port's services lacking compared to our competitors?

Track
How many vessels visited our competitor's port?

Every vessel call at a competitor port, counted for, without access to that port’s systems.

Classify
Which operations were carried out?

Each call is classified as cargo, bunkering, anchorage or transit, so only real operations count.

Benchmark
How do we prepare and what’s coming?

Forecasts of vessel arrivals, bunkering and service demand, so you can plan berths, staff and services ahead.

GLOBAL BENCHMARKING

Local AIS ends at 30-40 nautical miles. Competition does not.

PORTEX lets users assess competitor's port metrics beyond their own geographical reach.

See where you fall behind competitors and act before it costs you business.

02 PORTWISE
AI-powered assistant for port operations
Port operationsBrokersAgents

Port knowledge is spread across many documents. PORTWISE gives it in one reliable way.

PORTWISE is a natural language assistant built for port operations. It finds answers across regulations, procedures, service information and contracts held in separate systems, and makes them easy to use in day-to-day work.

Answers come only from your approved documents, so every response is cited in your organisation's official documents.

03 Tailored Projects
Maritime consulting, from use case to working tool
PortsShipping companiesMaritime organisations

When the maritime question is specific to you, the tool should be too.

SPACE-SHIP also delivers tailored projects for any maritime-related question, for all maritime stakeholders. We help clients define use cases, assess available data, design meaningful solutions and build tools that put insights into practice.

01
Define the use case

Agree the decision the tool has to support, and who will use it.

02
Assess available data

EO, GNSS AIS and market intelligence alongside the client's own records.

03
Design meaningful indicators

Turn the data into a small set of indicators tied to the decision.

04
Build it into practice

Test the approach with the people who will use it, then develop it into a service.

What a project can include
Traffic analysis Demand forecasting Heterogenous data integration Geospatial dashboards AI-powered solutions Decision-support applications Feasibility studies Demonstration projects
